title: "Even GPT Can Reject Me": Conceptualizing Abrupt Refusal Secondary Harm (ARSH) and Reimagining Psychological AI Safety with Compassionate Completion Standard (CCS)
reasoning: The paper focuses on operationalizing clinical and counseling ethics into AI safety protocols. It specifically discusses and applies ethical principles such as beneficence, nonmaleficence, veracity, and fidelity, and proposes a framework (CCS) grounded in ethical guidelines from psychotherapy.
